neon.isolation: Dedicated Production Neon project/database; DEV/TEST database or branch reuse is forbidden.

r2.isolation: Dedicated private Production bucket and bucket-scoped runtime token; TEST token/bucket reuse is forbidden.

iam.runtimeSecretAccess: Grant roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor only on the four CKACE_HR Production secrets.
iam.serviceIdentity: Bind both Production Cloud Run services to the dedicated CKACE_HR Production runtime service account.
iam.deploymentBoundary: Deployment identity privileges remain separate from runtime identity and are granted only at an Owner-approved provisioning/deploy gate.

ownerApprovalRequiredBefore: Create or mutate Production Cloud Run services
Create or mutate Production runtime service account or IAM
Create Production Neon resources or write Production data
Create Production R2 bucket/token or credentials
Create Production Secret Manager secrets or versions
Create/attach Production Firebase Hosting site or custom domain
